steps.title: Set Anchor Brackets and Hoist Mullions
steps.detail: Secure heavy steel dead-load anchor brackets to cast-in slab edge channels with T-head bolts. Hoist and plumb the 2-1/2 x 6 in vertical box mullions.

steps.title: Install Horizontal Transoms
steps.detail: Slide horizontal aluminum transoms over internal shear blocks at the sill, mid-rail, and head. Fasten through the transom web and seal joint abutments.

steps.title: Place Insulated Glass Units
steps.detail: Position 1-inch Low-E double-glazed units using vacuum suction lifters onto dense neoprene setting blocks seated within the glazing pocket.

steps.title: Fasten Aluminum Pressure Plates
steps.detail: Mount thermal isolator strips and clamp aluminum pressure plates over the perimeter glass edges using stainless hex screws torqued to 45 in-lbs.

steps.title: Snap On Exterior Face Caps
steps.detail: Engage continuous extruded aluminum beauty cover caps over the pressure plate clips using a non-marring rubber mallet to form the finished envelope.

steps.title: Prepare Substrate and Starter Strip
steps.detail: Fasten weather-resistive barrier over corner sheathing with cap staples. Tack a continuous 3/8-inch wood starter strip along the bottom plate line to kick out the first siding course.

steps.title: Install Two-Piece Outside Corner Boards
steps.detail: Lap the 1x5 corner board over the edge of the 1x4 face board to form a balanced square outside corner. Plumb the assembly with a 4-foot level and nail into corner framing with stainless casing nails.

steps.title: Hang Initial Bevel Lap Siding Courses
steps.detail: Butt the first cedar plank tightly against the corner board and starter strip, leaving a 1/8-inch expansion gap. Face-nail 1/2 inch above the lap into studs using ring-shank siding nails.

steps.title: Gauge Exposure and Complete Upper Courses
steps.detail: Use a story pole to maintain a uniform 4-1/2 inch reveal on subsequent courses. Continue driving stainless fasteners perpendicular to the wall plane without overdriving into the soft cedar grain.

steps.title: Position Vessel Shell on Shop Saddles
steps.detail: Set the rolled SA-516 Grade 70 cylinder course onto the twin fabricated cradle saddles. Check axial level with a precision machinist level and verify centerline orientation.

steps.title: Fit 2:1 Ellipsoidal Head and Girth Dogs
steps.detail: Hoist the formed ellipsoidal head against the shell course, establishing a uniform 3/32-inch root opening. Tack bridge dogs across the circumferential seam and drive tapered wedges to flush the joint.

steps.title: Fit Reinforcing Pad over Penetration
steps.detail: Position the curved reinforcing pad concentric with the upper shell nozzle cutout. Orient the 1/4-inch NPT telltale hole downward to ensure drainage and clearance for post-weld pneumatic leak testing.

steps.title: Align and Tack Welding Neck Nozzle
steps.detail: Insert the 6-inch Class 150 welding neck nozzle through the pad opening. Straddle the bolt holes across vessel centerlines using two-hole pins and square the flange face before depositing four heavy E7018 tack welds.

steps.title: Erect Timber Post & Post Cap
steps.detail: Stand the 6x6 PT post plumb in both axes. Seat the steel post-to-beam connector cap flush over the post head and secure the lower side flanges into the timber with 16d connector nails.

steps.title: Laminate and Seat Triple 2x10 Girder
steps.detail: Crown all three 2x10 framing members upward. Seat the laminated beam into the upper saddle of the post cap, nail the lamination plies together with staggered 16d nails, and nail cap flanges to girder beam faces.

steps.title: Lap and Fasten Floor Joists
steps.detail: Place 2x10 floor joists bearing fully across the 114 mm girder width. Face-nail the overlapping joist plies together with three 10d nails and toenail each joist to the girder with two 16d framing nails.

steps.title: Assemble Carcass Box
steps.detail: Glue and clamp bottom deck panel and top stretchers between gable panels. Secure joints with 1-1/4 inch pocket hole screws driven through predrilled pocket bores.

steps.title: Square and Fasten Back Panel
steps.detail: Check carcass diagonal squareness. Seat the 1/4 inch plywood back into the perimeter rear rabbet and fasten along all perimeter edges.

steps.title: Mount Maple Face Frame
steps.detail: Align face frame outer edges flush with cabinet gables and bottom rail flush with the shelf deck. Clamp securely and drive pocket hole screws into the frame rear.

steps.title: Set Adjustable Interior Shelf
steps.detail: Insert nickel shelf support pins into the 32mm system line bores at the desired height and set the interior shelf flat across all four pins.

steps.title: Hang Door and Hardware
steps.detail: Press 35mm concealed Euro cup hinges into door bores, clip hinge arms onto face-frame mounting plates, and mount the cabinet bar pull.

steps.title: Subfloor Moisture Prep
steps.detail: Inspect the 23/32 in T&G plywood subfloor for planar tolerance and moisture vapor emissions. Roll out and trim the vapor retarder membrane flush to all perimeter edges.

steps.title: Perimeter Tack Strip Installation
steps.detail: Fasten architectural tack strips around the room perimeter with ring-shank nails. Angle pins toward the wall line and maintain an exact 3/8 in tucking gully.

steps.title: Cushion Pad Placement
steps.detail: Lay the bonded urethane foam cushion pad net against the inside edges of the tack strips. Ensure flat placement without overlapping or covering strip pin rows.

steps.title: Carpet Stretching and Threshold Trim
steps.detail: Stretch and hook the tufted carpet onto tack strip pins, tuck raw edges neatly into the perimeter gully, and screw-fasten the fluted aluminum transition bar at the entrance threshold.

steps.title: Erect Double Top Plate on Center Bearing Wall
steps.detail: Align lower and upper 2x4 plates along the centerline and nail together using 16d common framing nails spaced 16 inches on center.

steps.title: Position and Toenail Rear Ceiling Joists
steps.detail: Set 2x6 ceiling joists on edge at 16 inches on center with full bearing over the center wall. Toenail each joist to the double plate with three 10d nails.

steps.title: Lap and Face-Nail Opposing Front Ceiling Joists
steps.detail: Place opposing ceiling joists flush against the rear joists over the bearing plate. Face-nail the joist lap with four 10d nails and toenail each joist foot into the plate.

steps.title: Fasten Strongback Base Board Across Mid-Span
steps.detail: Lay a 2x6 flat across the rear joist span at mid-point. Nail flat through the 2x6 into the top edge of each joist with two 16d nails to align and level the ceiling plane.

steps.title: Fasten Strongback Vertical Stiffener Leg
steps.detail: Stand the 2x4 on edge on the joists tight against the rear edge of the flat 2x6. Face-nail through the 2x4 upright into the edge of the flat 2x6 with 10d nails every 12 inches to form a rigid L-beam.

steps.title: Fasten Subfloor Plywood Base
steps.detail: Verify plywood subfloor deflection and fasten securely to joists, leaving standard 1/8-inch expansion gaps at panel perimeters.

steps.title: Embed Schluter-DITRA Membrane
steps.detail: Comb ANSI A118.11 modified thin-set mortar over the plywood using a 1/4-inch square-notch trowel. Roll out DITRA and embed fleece backing firmly with a float.

steps.title: Set Back Row of Porcelain Tiles
steps.detail: Fill DITRA dovetail cavities with mortar and comb in straight ridges. Bed the back row of 12x12-inch tiles with a twisting motion maintaining 1/8-inch joints.

steps.title: Set Front Tiles & Anchor Edge Profile
steps.detail: Set front field tiles along layout lines. Bed the anchoring leg of the Schluter-JOLLY aluminum profile into thin-set flush along the exposed tile transition edge.

steps.title: Cast Footing and Place Dowels
steps.detail: Form and pour the continuous concrete footing. Embed Grade 60 #4 vertical rebar dowels aligned precisely with future reinforced CMU cores.

steps.title: Lay First CMU Course
steps.detail: Spread a full 10 mm bed of Type M mortar onto the footing. Position hollow 8x8x16 blocks over dowels, keeping coursing level and plumb.

steps.title: Set Second Course in Running Bond
steps.detail: Stagger joints by 200 mm using half-blocks at the wall leads. Verify that vertical hollow cores align continuously from the footing upward.

steps.title: Lay Third Stem Wall Course
steps.detail: Butter head and bed joints and set the top course flush with the bottom courses. Check face plumb and overall wall height.

steps.title: Grout Reinforced Cores and Set Anchor Bolts
steps.detail: Fill cells containing rebar dowels with fine pea-gravel grout and consolidate. Embed 1/2-inch anchor J-bolts leaving projection for mudsill framing.

steps.title: Compact Subgrade & Set Edge Forms
steps.detail: Prepare compacted granular base course true to grade. Assemble 2x4 edge forms square and plumb, securing them firmly with driven exterior wooden stakes.

steps.title: Place Reinforcement Chairs & WWR Mesh
steps.detail: Distribute plastic bolster chairs across the granular subgrade. Lay 6x6 welded wire reinforcement mesh over the chairs to guarantee 2-inch bottom clearance and mid-slab depth.

steps.title: Deposit Concrete & Internally Consolidate
steps.detail: Discharge ready-mix concrete into the formwork around the wire reinforcement. Insert the immersion vibrator head vertically into the fresh concrete to consolidate air voids without shifting the steel.

steps.title: Strike Off Slab Surface with Screed Board
steps.detail: Rest the 2x4 straightedge screed board across the edge form tops. Advance the board in a rhythmic sawing stroke to strike off excess concrete level with the forms.

steps.title: Sole Plates Layout
steps.detail: Fasten Wall 1 sole plate and butt the return sole plate tightly against its interior edge at a 90-degree angle. Check squareness with a framing square.

steps.title: California Corner Sub-Assembly
steps.detail: Nail the drywall backing stud flatwise to the inside edge of the exterior corner stud using 10d nails at 300 mm spacing, creating an interior drywall catch lip and an open cavity for batt insulation.

steps.title: Wall 1 Framing & Top Plate
steps.detail: Erect the corner sub-assembly along with the intermediate and end studs onto the sole plate, securing the lower top plate flush over all studs with two 16d nails per stud end.

steps.title: Return Wall Framing & Lead Stud
steps.detail: Face-nail the return lead stud directly against the drywall backing stud of the corner assembly, erect remaining studs, and nail the lower top plate over Wall 2.

steps.title: Double Top Plate Lap Tie
steps.detail: Lap the upper cap plate from Wall 2 across the corner junction over Wall 1, butting the Wall 1 cap plate against it and face-nailing to interlock the intersecting wall planes.

steps.title: Establish Outrigger Pads and Dunnage
steps.detail: Inspect subgrade and place composite outrigger pads level on stable ground. Set hardwood timber dunnage blocks squarely across the pad centers to support steel landing.

steps.title: Land Structural Steel Beam
steps.detail: Lower the W12x40 wide-flange beam squarely onto timber dunnage blocks. Verify flange seating stability and balanced center of gravity before connecting rigging.

steps.title: Rig Crosby Screw-Pin Shackles
steps.detail: Position Crosby 6.5-ton anchor shackles over lifting points on the beam top flange. Hand-tighten each screw pin until fully seated, then back off one-quarter turn to prevent binding under load.

steps.title: Hook Bridle Sling and Hoist Block
steps.detail: Connect Grade 100 wire rope bridle legs into the shackle bows and master link. Lower crane hook into the master link bowl and confirm the safety keeper snaps shut.

steps.title: Layout plates and studs
steps.detail: Lay the sole plate and top plate together on edge to mark king and end stud locations. Nail the outer end studs and full-height king studs between the plates with two 16d common nails per stud end.

steps.title: Install jack studs
steps.detail: Place jack studs tight against the inside face of each king stud resting directly on the sole plate. Face-nail to king studs every 12 inches staggered and toenail into the sole plate.

steps.title: Set built-up 2x6 header
steps.detail: Rest the sandwiched 2x6 header assembly on top of the trimmer shoulders. End-nail through both king studs into the header ends using four 16d nails per side.

steps.title: Fasten top cripple studs
steps.detail: Install header cripple studs centered over the rough opening between header top and top plate. Toenail to the header and end-nail through the top plate.

steps.title: Fasten double top cap plate
steps.detail: Position the cap plate directly over the top plate and secure with 16d framing nails spaced 16 inches on center. Check assembly diagonally for square.

steps.title: Position Dredge Ladder Boom on Assembly Saddles
steps.detail: Set the heavy structural steel ladder boom arm onto shop assembly saddles and verify level alignment along both axes.

steps.title: Install Dredge Suction Pipeline
steps.detail: Hoist suction pipe along the ladder belly framing and fasten flanged brackets directly behind the suction mouth intake hood.

steps.title: Mount Cutterhead Drive and Nose Shaft Assembly
steps.detail: Rig planetary drive gearbox to the forward ladder bulkhead plate, then fasten the water-flushed bearing hub.

steps.title: Mount Rotating Cutter Basket to Drive Spline
steps.detail: Slide the splined cast alloy steel basket onto the shaft journal, pull tight with retention hardware, and check radial runout.

steps.title: Seat Replaceable Carbide Cutter Teeth
steps.detail: Drive carbide chisel teeth into helical arm adapter pockets and drive heavy spring roll pins flush to lock.

steps.title: Erect Stud Framing Wall
steps.detail: Plumb and square 2x4 studs at 16 inches on center between the top and sole plates. End-nail two 16d framing nails through each plate into every stud.

steps.title: Hang Drywall Panels Horizontally
steps.detail: Position the upper panel snug against the top boundary, then abut the lower panel to meet at factory tapered edges. Fasten with 1-1/4 in Type W screws spaced 12 inches along each stud.

steps.title: Bed Paper Tape in Joint Compound
steps.detail: Butter the tapered recess with a 6-inch knife using all-purpose joint compound. Center the paper tape directly over the joint line and press flat to squeeze out excess mud without leaving voids.

steps.title: Apply Feathered Finish Skim Coat
steps.detail: After the bed coat has set, lay on topping compound with a 10-inch or 12-inch taping knife. Feather both outer edges smoothly flush into the gypsum board face.

steps.title: Frame Wall Section and Exterior Sheathing
steps.detail: Assemble sole plate, wall studs, and double top plates using 16d common nails. Fasten exterior OSB sheathing flush to the frame.

steps.title: Set Rafter Tails and Mount Wall Ledger
steps.detail: Fasten sloped 2x6 rafter tails over the double top plate and nail the continuous 2x4 lookout ledger horizontally into the wall framing.

steps.title: Install Lookouts and 2x6 Subfascia
steps.detail: End-nail horizontal 2x4 lookouts between the wall ledger and the plumb-cut rafter tails. Nail continuous 2x6 subfascia across rafter ends.

steps.title: Fasten Roof Sheathing Overhang
steps.detail: Nail 1/2-inch plywood roof decking across the sloped rafter tails flush with the top edge of the subfascia.

steps.title: Install Soffit Track, Vented Panel, and Cedar Fascia
steps.detail: Attach aluminum J-channel along the wall, slide the continuous perforated soffit panel flat against the lookouts, and face-nail the 1x8 primed cedar fascia.

steps.title: Construct 16-Inch OC Stud Bay Framing
steps.detail: Lay out sole and top plates. Face nail three 2x4 studs at 16 inches on center using two 16d framing nails per joint connection.

steps.title: Mount 200A Load Center Enclosure
steps.detail: Fit the 14-1/2 inch wide enclosure snugly between left and center studs. Fasten mounting side flanges flush with front drywall plane.

steps.title: Install Overhead EMT Conduit Runs
steps.detail: Seat 1/2-inch and 3/4-inch EMT conduits into top knockout openings using steel compression connectors secured with locknuts.

steps.title: Rough In Junction Box and NM-B Cables
steps.detail: Screw the 4-inch square steel junction box to the center stud. Pull 12/2 NM-B branch circuit cables through boring holes and secure with listed cable clamps.

steps.title: Anchor Hoistway Wall Brackets
steps.detail: Drill the concrete hoistway wall and set heavy-duty adjustable rail brackets using 3/4-inch wedge anchors. Verify horizontal elevation and plumb line offset with a level and tape.

steps.title: Stand Lower T-Rail and Fasten Clamp Clips
steps.detail: Hoist the lower machined T127 rail section onto the bracket seat plate. Engage ductile iron clamp clips over the base flange edges and hand-tighten tee-bolts.

steps.title: Fasten Splice Fishplate to Rail Back
steps.detail: Fit the forged steel fishplate to the rear flange of the lower rail and torque the lower two Grade 5 through-bolts. Leave the upper two holes ready to receive the succeeding rail section.

steps.title: Stack Upper Rail and Torque Clips
steps.detail: Lower the upper rail tongue into the lower rail groove, engage the upper fishplate bolts, and torque all rail clips and splice fasteners to ASME A17.1 specification.

steps.title: Erect and Plumb 4x4 Line Posts
steps.detail: Set the pressure-treated 4x4 line posts 1100 mm on center. Ensure both posts are plumb, parallel, and stable at 1800 mm standing height.

steps.title: Fasten Horizontal 2x4 Runners
steps.detail: Nail bottom, middle, and top 2x4 runners flat against post faces using two 3-inch ring-shank nails at each post connection.

steps.title: Affix Outer Guide Pickets
steps.detail: Align left and right boundary pickets flush with runner outer edges, maintaining 50 mm clearance above ground. Fasten with two ring-shank nails into each runner.

steps.title: Infill Field Privacy Pickets
steps.detail: Space remaining 6 cedar pickets evenly with 10 mm gaps across the rails. Secure each picket with two ring-shank nails into each framing runner.

steps.title: Mount Beam Clamps and Main Swivel Hangers
steps.detail: Attach heavy-duty beam clamps to the structural overhead beam flange. Suspend 3/8-inch threaded rods and install 2-inch UL/FM swivel ring hangers, leveling to ensure a 1/2-inch pitch per 10 feet.

steps.title: Hang Grooved Main Spools and Victaulic Tee
steps.detail: Rest the 2-inch roll-grooved black steel spools into the swivel rings. Position the Style 920 mechanical grooved tee at the center junction, torque housing bolts alternately to 50 ft-lb.

steps.title: Install Branch Strut and Swivel Hanger
steps.detail: Mount the Unistrut branch header channel perpendicular to the main beam. Fasten the 1-inch swivel ring hanger along the branch centerline at 150 mm forward of the main.

steps.title: Thread Branch Line and Reducing Elbow
steps.detail: Apply PTFE paste sealant to 1-inch male threads and engage the branch line into the mechanical tee collar. Thread on the 1-inch by 1/2-inch reducing elbow oriented vertically plumb.

steps.title: Install Brass Quick-Response Pendent Head
steps.detail: Apply three wraps of approved PTFE tape to the 1/2-inch NPT head threads. Thread the 155°F pendent sprinkler head into the drop elbow using an open-end sprinkler wrench, protecting the red glass bulb.

steps.title: Rim Joists & Floor Joist Layout
steps.detail: Crown all 2x10 joists upward and align on 16-inch centers. Fasten rim joists to each joist end using three 16d common framing nails.

steps.title: Mid-Span Staggered Solid Blocking
steps.detail: Install full-depth 2x10 solid blocks at joist mid-span, alternating front and back by 38 mm to permit direct face-nailing through adjacent joists with two 16d nails per block end.

steps.title: First Course Subfloor Installation
steps.detail: Apply a continuous 1/4-inch bead of polyurethane subfloor adhesive along the top of all framing members. Position 3/4-inch T&G panels perpendicular to joists, centering butt seams over joist flanges, and screw every 6 inches along edges and 12 inches in the field.

steps.title: Second Course Subfloor Stagger
steps.detail: Start the second course with a short cut panel to offset butt joints by two joist bays (32 inches). Fully engage the tongue-and-groove joint and secure with 2-inch subfloor screws.

steps.title: Set Footing Reinforcement and Dowels
steps.detail: Support two longitudinal #4 rebar on chairs 3 inches above the trench bottom and tie vertical rebar dowels along the centerline to lap into the stem wall.

steps.title: Pour Continuous Concrete Footing
steps.detail: Place 3000 PSI concrete into the footing trench to a full 10-inch thickness and screed flat, leaving vertical dowels exposed for monolithic bond.

steps.title: Form Stem Wall and Wet-Set Anchor Bolts
steps.detail: Erect 8-inch wall forms over the footing, pour the stem wall, and wet-set 1/2-inch J-bolts at 7 inches embedment, keeping 68 mm exposed plumb.

steps.title: Roll Out Sill Sealer Gasket
steps.detail: Lay closed-cell polyethylene foam sill sealer along the top of the cured stem wall to act as an airtight capillary break.

steps.title: Position Treated 2x6 Mudsill Plate
steps.detail: Bore 5/8-inch clearance holes through the pressure-treated 2x6 plate and lower it onto the sill sealer over the anchor bolt stems.

steps.title: Secure Plate Washers and Nuts
steps.detail: Place 3x3-inch heavy steel plate washers over each anchor bolt and torque galvanized hex nuts down until the mudsill sits flush and uniform.

steps.title: Form Concrete Footing and Stem Wall
steps.detail: Cast reinforced concrete strip footing and 8-inch basement stem wall. Cure concrete, knock off tie fins, and fill surface bugholes.

steps.title: Install Cant Strip and Elastomeric Membrane
steps.detail: Tool a 45-degree polymer-modified mortar cant at the footing-to-wall junction. Spray a continuous 60-mil elastomeric membrane over the stem wall face and cant down onto the footing shelf.

steps.title: Hang Dimpled Drainage Composite Board
steps.detail: Fasten dimpled core drainage board with dimples facing inward toward the wall membrane. Terminate top edge at planned finished grade with a mechanical termination bar.

steps.title: Place Stone Bedding and Perforated Drain Tile
steps.detail: Spread a 2-inch leveling bed of washed 3/4-inch crushed gravel on the footing shelf. Lay 4-inch perforated PVC pipe with perforation rows oriented downward at the 4 and 8 o'clock positions.

steps.title: Encase in Gravel Envelope and Filter Fabric
steps.detail: Cover pipe with washed 3/4-inch drainage stone to a minimum 12-inch depth. Encapsulate the entire stone drainage envelope with non-woven geotextile filter fabric to prevent silt intrusion.

steps.title: Assemble Carcase Base and Gables
steps.detail: Drive steel connecting pins into side gables and tap fluted dowels into mating plinth holes. Lock the bottom panel and plinths between gables using zinc cam locks.

steps.title: Secure Upper Stretchers and Back Panel
steps.detail: Fit front and rear stretchers between the gables with cam pins. Insert the rear backer sheet into gable grooves and tack along the base perimeter.

steps.title: Mount Ball-Bearing Drawer Slides
steps.detail: Index carcase slide rails against pre-drilled System 32 pilot holes on both interior gable faces and drive Euro mounting screws flush.

steps.title: Install Solid Pine Top Panel
steps.detail: Align wooden dowels on the upper stretcher surfaces with the tabletop underside. Drive upward connecting screws through stretcher clearance slots to pull the top flush.

steps.title: Assemble Drawer and Slide into Carcase
steps.detail: Join drawer box sides and sub-front around the bottom board, secure the decorative pine face with the steel pull handle, and engage drawer members into carcase slides until locked.

steps.title: Frame Gable and Interior Support Walls
steps.detail: Anchor 2x4 sole plates and erect vertical wall studs cut to rake pitch, plumbing and bracing each post securely.

steps.title: Install Interior Common & Dropped Gable Rafters
steps.detail: Mount the full-height 2x6 common rafter on interior studs and place the 2x6 dropped gable rafter exactly 1-1/2 in lower on the gable wall.

steps.title: Install Cantilevered 2x4 Lookout Blocks
steps.detail: Lay 2x4 lookouts flatwise over the dropped gable rafter, end-nailing through the interior common rafter and face-nailing to the gable rafter.

steps.title: Fasten Outer Fly Rafter (Barge Rafter)
steps.detail: Face-nail the outer fly rafter against the projecting ends of the lookouts, keeping its top edge flush with the common rafter plane.

steps.title: Fasten CDX Roof Sheathing
steps.detail: Fasten 1/2 in CDX plywood sheathing across common rafter, lookouts, and fly rafter to form a rigid overhang diaphragm.

steps.title: Erect Double Top Plates
steps.detail: Install lower and upper 2x4 top plates across north and south bearing walls. Stagger joints and nail upper plates to lower plates with 16d common nails.

steps.title: Install Ceiling Joists (Rafter Ties)
steps.detail: Position 2x6 ceiling joists across bearing walls on 800 mm centers. Toenail each joist end to the top plates with three 16d nails to resist outward roof thrust.

steps.title: Raise 2x8 Ridge Board
steps.detail: Hoist the 2x8 ridge board on temporary center uprights. Level along the 2400 mm length and confirm height and alignment on the building centerline.

steps.title: Erect 6:12 Pitch Common Rafters
steps.detail: Fit opposing 2x6 rafter pairs with 26.6° plumb cuts tight against the ridge board and seat birdsmouth cuts over top plates. Face-nail rafter heels directly to ceiling joists.

steps.title: Secure Hurricane Ties at Plates
steps.detail: Fasten galvanized hurricane ties to the rafter side and upper top plate at each bearing point to resist wind uplift forces.

steps.title: Fasten Upper Collar Ties
steps.detail: Nail 2x4 collar ties horizontally across rafters in the upper third of attic height. Fasten each end with three 10d nails to resist collar separation under wind uplift.

steps.title: Position EPDM Setting Blocks at Quarter Points
steps.detail: Seat two 85-durometer neoprene setting blocks inside the sill glazing pocket at 1/4 and 3/4 points of the daylight opening to properly carry the dead load of the unit.

steps.title: Set 1-inch Insulated Glass Unit into Glazing Pocket
steps.detail: Grip the IGU using vacuum suction cups. Insert the upper edge fully into the deep head pocket, swing the bottom inward, and lower onto the setting blocks with equal edge clearance on both jambs.

steps.title: Engage Snap-in Glazing Bead & Roll in Gaskets
steps.detail: Hook the interior glazing bead into the sill pocket receiver and tap flush using a non-marring dead-blow mallet. Roll the exterior and interior EPDM wedge gaskets into place to lock the glass under uniform compression.

steps.title: Excavate Advance Cut with Trenching Bucket

steps.title: Cast and Consolidate Footing Concrete

steps.detail: Install 90 mm pine baseboard tight against the drywall floor line. Apply 1 in blue painter's tape along the top edge of the baseboard, burnishing the edge to prevent paint bleed.

steps.detail: Apply a uniform coat of PVA drywall primer across all drywall faces and joint compound to equalize surface porosity and prevent topcoat flashing.

steps.title: Install Interior Floor Joists

steps.detail: Install heavy-gauge swivel brackets into cast-in wall coil inserts and anchor floor pivot shoes into the cured slab using wedge anchors.

steps.title: Set Hardwood Dunnage on Trailer Deck
steps.detail: Inspect the drop-deck surface and place rough-sawn 4x4 oak dunnage timbers across the deck boards to maximize friction and isolate steel cargo.

steps.detail: Lower the machined steel ballast block symmetrically onto both dunnage timbers along the trailer centerline to ensure balanced axle loading.

steps.title: Position Steel Corner Edge Protectors
steps.detail: Place forged 90-degree steel corner protectors at all four upper load edges to shield transport chains from sharp-edge bending stresses.

steps.title: Install and Tension Transport Chains
steps.detail: Anchor 3/8-inch Grade 70 chains into deck D-rings, drape over corner protectors, engage ratchet binders, and crank to DOT pre-tension specifications.

steps.detail: Lay the bottom sole plate on the framing deck. Position the two perimeter corner studs flush with both ends and secure through the bottom plate into the stud end grain using two 16d common nails each.

steps.title: Top plate installation and squaring
steps.detail: Align the single top plate over the outer studs flush at both ends. Drive two 16d common framing nails through the top plate into each stud, checking frame diagonals to verify squareness.

steps.title: Field stud installation (16 in O.C.)
steps.detail: Insert the five intermediate pre-cut studs on 16-inch centers marked along the plates. Fasten each stud with two 16d common nails through the top plate and two through the bottom sole plate.

steps.title: Cap plate lamination
steps.detail: Nail the double top cap plate directly over the first top plate to tie the assembly together. Fasten with 16d framing nails spaced 16 inches on center in a staggered pattern.

steps.detail: Adhere DuPont FlexWrap sill membrane centered along rough sill, molding seamless 6-inch upstands at side jambs and folding the apron onto exterior sheathing.

steps.title: Place Leveling Shims
steps.detail: Set composite leveling shims on top of the sill pan under future side stile locations. Confirm shim plane is level across the rough opening width.

steps.title: Set and Fasten Window Unit
steps.detail: Apply continuous sealant beads along top and side sheathing. Seat window unit squarely onto shims and fasten perimeter side flanges with roofing nails.

steps.title: Install Head Drip Cap and Flashing Tape
steps.detail: Fit rigid metal Z-drip cap over top head flange. Seal jamb flanges with butyl flashing tape, then tape the drip cap upstand directly to sheathing beneath the WRB flap.

steps.title: Frame perimeter and king studs
steps.detail: Lay out plates and end-nail the full-height end studs and king studs through sole and top plates using two 16d common nails per joint.

steps.title: Fasten trimmer jack studs
steps.detail: Nail trimmer jack studs flush against the inner face of king studs with staggered 10d nails spaced 12 inches on center.

steps.title: Set rough opening header
steps.detail: Drop the built-up 2x6 header onto the trimmer shoulders. End-nail four 16d nails through each king stud into the header ends.

steps.title: Install bottom cripples and rough sill
steps.detail: Toenail bottom cripple studs to sole plate, then level and nail the rough sill across cripples and into jack studs to establish the 48-inch opening height.

steps.title: Install top cripples and cap plate
steps.detail: Fit top cripples between header and top plate. Nail down the second cap plate with staggered 16d nails, verifying diagonal squareness.
